title: Different alphabets: a dead state for the missing symbol
notes: A reads only a, B reads a and b. The product reads both, so A gets a dead state for b: a word with a b in it is never in A. B still decides those words, so (dead, q1) accepts.
ops: start p0; accept p1; p0 a -> p1; p1 a -> p0 | start q0; accept q1; q0 a -> q0; q0 b -> q1; q1 a -> q0; q1 b -> q1
